Three findings the calorie model leaves out.

What the research shows, and how sure we are. Every recommendation in the app is sourced.

General guidance only. Your clinician stays your clinician.

01

Insulin sensitivity shifts weekly

Higher in week two, lower in week four. So your carbs move with the week.

Supported

Yeung et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab, 2010
02

Metabolism rises before your period

A little higher, with real hunger to match. Your body is doing more work.

Supported

Benton et al., PLoS One, 2020
03

Long fasts cost women more

Most fasting research was run on men. Early evidence suggests women’s stress response to long fasts differs, so we keep windows shorter.

Emerging

Heilbronn et al., Obesity Research, 2005
